remarks: Welcome to this exquisite Colonial home, nestled in one of Stamford's most enchanting neighborhoods and listed on the National Registry of Historic Homes. As you step inside, you'll immediately appreciate the thoughtfully designed floor plan, including four generously sized bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and an abundance of natural light that fills every corner of the home. Soaring ceilings, recess lighting and beautifully restored hardwood floors enhance the warm and inviting ambiance, creating the perfect setting for both intimate gatherings and larger celebrations. The kitchen has been thoughtfully updated, including all stainless steel appliances, leading seamlessly to a spacious laundry room. The living room and dining room are both grand and majestic. Outside, you'll discover a serene, level backyard complete with a sprinkler system and new Trex deck-ideal for alfresco dining or simply savoring peaceful mornings with a cup of coffee. Additional updates, include a brand-new roof, water heater, and attic insulation, ensuring peace of mind for years to come. The primary bathroom has been renovated into a beautiful luxurious spa, including a heated towel warmer and steam shower. Conveniently located just minutes from vibrant downtown Stamford and the train station, this meticulously maintained home offers the perfect blend of historic charm and modern amenities. Don't miss the opportunity to make this timeless treasure your own!
